prerequisites: Each supported source generation on Fabric and NeoForge
A zero-experience player and a real AnvilMenu
A damaged item carrying name, enchantment, and custom components
steps: Repair damage values 1, 64, 65, and 500 with sufficient and insufficient dark matter
Take the output as a zero-experience player and record both input slots and output components
In the same menu, replace a valid input with undamaged, non-damageable, wrong-material, and empty inputs
assertions: Exactly min(ceil(damage / 64), available) materials are consumed
Output count is one and all left-stack components except damage are preserved
Experience cost is zero and pickup succeeds at zero experience
Every invalid input clears custom pickup permission, material cost, and output without stale state

prerequisites: Controlled environments with neither, either, and both Create and Botania installed
Fresh villager trade registries for each supported generation
steps: Enumerate armorer, toolsmith, and control-profession trade pools at levels 1 and 3
Reload datapacks in all four optional-dependency combinations
Decode present optional recipes through the owning mod's real RecipeSerializer
assertions: Only armorer and toolsmith receive one emerald to one dark matter trades at levels 1 and 3
Recipes are absent when their owner mod is absent
Recipes present with their owner mod decode and enter the live recipe registry without codec errors
